title: Left exact left adjoints induce left exact left adjoints on slice categories
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be categories having finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]. Let $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ preserve finite limits and have a right adjoint $T:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, meaning natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(L A,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(A,T B)$. For $X\in\mathcal A$, the slice $\mathcal A/X$ has objects arrows $a:A\to X$ and morphisms $f:(A,a)\to(A\prime,a\prime)$ satisfying $a\prime f=a$. Define $L_X:\mathcal A/X\to\mathcal B/LX$ by $(A\xrightarrow a X)\mapsto(LA\xrightarrow{L a}LX)$ and $f\mapsto L f$. Then $L_X$ preserves finite limits and has a right adjoint.
